correctness.rationale: Every upward Boolean Hasse edge increases rank, so admissibility is exactly the independent in/out-degree condition and splits across rank factors. The outer factors have homotopy wedge three zero-spheres; each middle factor has 162 nonempty faces, 78 verified acyclic Morse pairs, one critical vertex and five critical two-cells, hence an integral wedge of five two-spheres. The join yields 225 seven-spheres. Exact signed Lefschetz traces on all \(S_4\) elements yield the stated character and rational isotypic multiplicities. An independent whole-digraph 32-arc degree-constrained DP agrees coefficientwise with the full 664225-term face enumeration including empty.

value.rationale: The upward-oriented Boolean four-cube is a canonical Hasse digraph and the first dimension exhibiting a genuinely non-path middle rank incidence module. The result completely determines an integral homotopy type and natural 225-dimensional \(S_4\) representation, including ten invariant classes. This is a motivated exact classification of a standard finite object and a reusable rank-join method; it does not claim a general theorem for higher dimensions or a new general decomposition principle.
